items.title: Joseph Thomas Interview, 1960-09-29
items.q: We were good friends you know.

ctx.x: I don't remember that he ever told me that. I heard he didn't but I went back to the Albert. Piku told me once that he had learned a little bit on the bam but never did play it much I don't think. I think one time he could play both of them.
Yes. Yeah Piku was a yes talking about the old clarinet another one I used to like too. I just know one name they call him Zeb.
Oh yeah I've heard of him.
